items.text: Jeremiyah Love QUESTIONABLE/game-time decision (high ankle sprain); limited practices. Allgeier ready for increased work if limited/out.
items.why: High ankle from preseason; limited all week.
items.implication: If active, shared work/efficiency dip possible; monitor warmups.

items.text: Malik Nabers listed QUESTIONABLE (knee/ACL recovery) despite full practices; Giants elevated WR Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre from PS as contingency. Nabers has final say on playing to avoid career risk.
items.implication: Monitor inactives closely; if OUT, Fields/Mooney/Berrios see bump. If IN, start but temper volume.
items.opportunity: If OUT: elevated routes/targets for secondary WRs; if IN limited snaps possible.

items.text: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa OUT (oblique); Cooper Rush will start vs PIT despite experiencing back spasms Saturday. Penix also out.
items.why: Oblique injury in practice; Rush confirmed starter post-spasms.
items.implication: More run-heavy script favors Bijan; lower ceilings for London/Pitts due to QB downgrade and chemistry.
items.opportunity: Bijan snap/carry share up; London/Pitts volume risk.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ruled OUT for Week 1 (and potentially Week 2) after meniscus trim procedure on previously injured knee. Michael Mayer expected to see elevated role and targets as primary TE.
items.why: Meniscus procedure this week; same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise.
items.implication: Mayer becomes top streamer/TE1 option; Raiders pass game shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Mayer; possible more Jeanty involvement in passing.

items.text: Bucs RB Sean Tucker DOUBTFUL/OUT (hamstring); elevated Josh Williams. Bucky Irving and Gainwell primary backfield.
items.implication: Clearer path for Irving lead + Gainwell change-of-pace/GL.
items.opportunity: Irving/Gainwell snap and goal-line boost vs CIN.

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; NE WR corps reshuffles (Maye targets elsewhere).

items.text: Eagles downgraded TE Eli Stowers to OUT and placed on IR (quad). Dallas Goedert primary.
items.implication: Goedert locked as TE1 with full snaps/routes.
items.opportunity: Goedert target share secure vs WAS.

items.text: Cowboys placed RB Malik Davis on IR (hip) and signed Israel Abanikanda from PS to active roster.
items.implication: Handcuff loss; Abanikanda or others next up behind Javonte.
items.opportunity: Increased Javonte security; Abanikanda stash potential.

items.text: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow-paced slog. Full Week 1 snaps/pace updated for Tua/Bowers news. CHI/CAR total jumped.
items.why: Neutral pace projections adjusted for injuries/QB changes.
items.implication: Volume boost for NO/DET skill players; lower for MIA/LV.
items.opportunity: Higher snap totals in up-pace games favor RBs/WRs.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty fully cleared and practicing without restrictions/no designation for Week 1 vs MIA after ankle sprain. Expected full go as lead back.
items.why: Full practices all week; no injury designation on final report.
items.implication: Start as RB1/high-end RB2; ADP boost from clearance.
items.opportunity: Lead carries, potential goal-line/receiving work vs soft MIA front.

items.text: Alvin Kamara QUESTIONABLE (MCL/knee) but full Friday practice; Etienne likely to handle significant early workload regardless.
items.why: MCL sprain recovery; full practice but caution expected.
items.implication: Fade Kamara Week 1; Etienne upgrade in committee/lead.
items.opportunity: Etienne carries/targets up in NO@DET high-pace game.

items.text: Rome Odunze QUESTIONABLE (calf); limited all week. Coach skeptical but player plans to play—have backup ready. Temper expectations if active.
items.implication: If OUT, Burden/others elevated; if IN, reduced efficiency.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler amid Brooks return and committee talk.
items.why: Viable volume in split; Brooks cleared but Hubbard 100%.
items.implication: Flex consideration in good matchup; monitor split.
items.opportunity: Still meaningful carries/routes vs CAR defense.

items.text: Raiders TE Michael Mayer agreed to 3-year $45M extension ($30M guaranteed, 4th in APY among TEs). First Raiders rookie-deal extension since Renfrow.
items.implication: Job security and role locked; strong stream while Bowers out.
items.opportunity: Immediate target share spike + long-term TE value.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey is a BUY LOW despite preseason usage concerns and Kaelon Black looking good. Banged up preseason, long flight, weird game environment—not worried about role.
items.why: Contrarian take on early usage freakout; expects bounce-back.
items.implication: Hold/start confidently; trade market opportunity if others panic.

items.text: Saquon Barkley averages 136.5 rush yards and 6.0 YPC vs WAS (4 games incl playoffs) with 21+ PPR every time; WAS front still projects below average.
items.opportunity: High volume and efficiency vs weak front.

items.text: Justin Herbert fantasy PPG per pass attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field; Alt healthy. Cards DL/secondary ranked bottom-tier preseason.
items.why: OL health boost + soft ARI pass rush/secondary.

items.text: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th in fantasy PPG per target last 3 years; Nabers won't be 100% and Giants WR2 is Fields or Mooney—gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Historical efficiency + Nabers uncertainty creates target vacuum.
items.implication: Start Likely with confidence as TE upside play.
